message.content: {"items": [{"hypothesis_id": "AND(SENSOR_BIAS,SPEED_STEP)", "rationale": "The context indicates recent motor servicing and pending belt-speed recalibration, supporting a speed step; the small consistent x-position offset supports sensor bias. The combined structure achieves the lowest RMSE among passing models (0.006174).", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "AND(SENSOR_BIAS,VELOCITY_OFFSET,SPEED_STEP)", "rationale": "This triple structure also fits well (RMSE 0.006153) and accounts for both a constant velocity offset and a speed step alongside sensor bias, consistent with pending recalibration after servicing.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "AND(SENSOR_BIAS,VELOCITY_OFFSET)", "rationale": "This combined model fits well (RMSE 0.007505) and explains both a constant bias and a velocity offset, though it does not explicitly capture the speed step suggested by the servicing context.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "SENSOR_BIAS", "rationale": "Single sensor bias fits well (RMSE 0.007777) and explains the consistent small x-offset, but does not account for the pending belt-speed recalibration context.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "VELOCITY_OFFSET", "rationale": "Velocity offset fits reasonably (RMSE 0.009494) and aligns with belt-speed recalibration being pending, but does not capture the constant sensor bias as well as combined models.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "SPEED_STEP", "rationale": "Speed step fits reasonably (RMSE 0.010504) and aligns with recent motor servicing, but does not capture the constant sensor bias as well as combined models.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "AND(VELOCITY_OFFSET,SPEED_STEP)", "rationale": "This combined model fits well (RMSE 0.007491) and accounts for both velocity offset and speed step, consistent with pending recalibration, but omits sensor bias.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}]}
